# <span id="aanchor452"></span> Instant Login

The Instant Login feature mimics Single Sign On capabilities and allows users to log in to pre-defined FLOWCAL databases using Windows credentials, either through command line or a shortcut.

<span id="VaultConfig"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Vault Utility">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Vault Configuration Utility</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Vault Utility">

The standalone Vault Configuration utility (FlowCal.VaultConfiguration) allows users to create .fcvault files that securely store one or more sets of login credentials. This utility is part of the FLOWCAL install set. A FLOWCAL installation will point to the vault file for use by the Instant Login process. Only members of the Windows Active Directory group FLOWCAL-VAULT-USER will be allowed to run and access the utility.

To configure utility access, the network administrator must first create the Active Directory group.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 398;height: 224;" />

The following items are available on the Vault Configuration utility:

- **Vault File** - The Windows path where the vault file is saved to.
- **Database** – Must be unique for the current fcvault file.
- **Username** – The username for the given database.
- **Password** – The password for the given username (password is case sensitive).
- **Add Row** – Add additional rows for more sets of login credentials.

For the utility to save:

- At least one record is required.
- Duplicate databases are not allowed.
- All fields (Database, Username, and Password) must be populated.

</div>

<span id="VaultLocation"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Instant Vault">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Instant Login Vault Location</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Instant Vault">

<div class="procedure">

To set a vault file location in FLOWCAL, or edit an existing location:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager** \> **Security** \> **Instant Login Vault**.

    Users must have **User Security - Can Create Application Process** or **User Security - Can Edit Application Process** privileges to access this screen.

2.  Click **Browse**.

3.  Select the file location and click **Save**.

4.  Click **Done**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 283;height: 174;" />

</div>

</div>

<span id="AccessConfig"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Access Config">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Access Configuration</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Access Config">

Instant User Designation

Options for configuring instant users are available on the [User Access](../Settings%20Manager/Security/User%20Access.md) screen.

Security Group Association

Associate Windows Active Directory groups with FLOWCAL security groups through the [Group Access](../Settings%20Manager/Security/Group%20Access.md) screen.

- Instant users do not need to belong to any AD security groups if the users are manually created; however, they will first need to be given permissions to access various FLOWCAL functions.
- If a new instant user belongs to at least one AD group, the AD group can be mapped to a FLOWCAL security group, which will give the user group-level security privileges upon logging in.
- When a Windows user who belongs to at least one AD group with FLOWCAL group mapping attempts to log in to FLOWCAL for the first time, FLOWCAL automatically creates an instant user with no user-level security privileges. The user will be granted group-level privileges based on the mapped FLOWCAL group.
- When instant users who belong to at least one AD group log in to FLOWCAL, their FLOWCAL group membership will be adjusted based the current AD/FLOWCAL group mapping. This only applies to automatically created instant users.

</div>

<span id="UserLogin"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="User Login">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />User Login</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="User Login">

Once set up, instant users may log in using the command line or a FLOWCAL.exe shortcut.

<div class="procedure">

To log in through command line:

1.  Open a command prompt.
2.  Navigate to the FLOWCAL install folder.
3.  Enter "FLOWCAL.exe" followed by the command line argument "/instant" and the database name.
4.  Press **Enter**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 477;height: 231;" />

To log in through a FLOWCAL.exe shortcut:

1.  Create a FLOWCAL.exe shortcut.
2.  Right-click the shortcut and select **Properties**.
3.  Click the **Shortcut** tab.
4.  Add the argument "/instant" and database name to the end of the **Target** field.
5.  Save the change.
6.  Double-click the shortcut.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 281;height: 391;" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Setup">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Setup Instructions</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Setup">

1.  The IT department will need to create a Windows Active Directory group called "FLOWCAL-VAULT-USER".

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 255;height: 218;" />

2.  When this AD group has been created, add all Windows users who will be using the Vault Configuration Utility feature (FlowcalVaultConfiguration.exe) to this group. If additional AD groups are desired (see examples in <a href="#AccessConfig" class="InlineLink">Access Configuration</a>), create the groups and add members.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 251;height: 219;" />

3.  In FLOWCAL, create a standard user to be used in the Vault Configuration Utility; this username credential will be used by the instant login functionality to connect all instant users to FLOWCAL.
    - This user will need **User Security** \> **Can Create** and **Can Edit** privileges, as well as any other permissions where an instant user that logs in through this vault standard user would require.
    - An existing standard user that meets this requirement can also be used for the utility.

4.  Create the fcvault file with the login credentials via the <a href="#VaultConfig" class="InlineLink">Vault Configuration Utility</a>.

5.  Log in to FLOWCAL as a standard user and set up the vault path (see <a href="#VaultLocation" class="InlineLink">Instant Login Vault Location</a>).

6.  Create users.
    - **Auto create instant users:**

    1.  1.  Set up the FLOWCAL security group/AD group association (see <a href="#AccessConfig" class="InlineLink">Access Configuration</a>).
        2.  Place the Windows users in the appropriate Windows AD group.
        3.  Create a FLOWCAL shortcut (see <a href="#UserLogin" class="InlineLink">User Login</a>) and log in. The new instant user is created during the first login and should be presented with the FLOWCAL main screen.

        Instant users created this way will inherit all security permissions from the assigned AD group. These instant user’s AD group membership will be updated automatically if the FLOWCAL security group/AD group association is changed.

    - **Manually create instant users** in the FLOWCAL User Access screen and assign appropriate user security permissions. Create a FLOWCAL shortcut (see <a href="#UserLogin" class="InlineLink">User Login</a>). Double-click the shortcut. The user should be logged into FLOWCAL automatically.

If customers want to log in as instant users with an existing FLOWCAL username, their FC username and Windows username must match. No method exists for converting existing standard users into instant users if these usernames do not match.

</div>
